summary: Meta launched Muse, a standalone personal AI agent, in the US in September 2026. It can search stores, fill a cart and make purchases after the user approves. Meta added Walmart, Gap and Best Buy, and Shopify is building agent checkouts with Shop Pay. Amazon blocked Muse from Amazon.com.

claims.claim: Meta launched Muse, its first standalone personal AI agent, on 8 September 2026, for US adults; it can send emails, book reservations, fill out forms and make purchases.
claims.source_title: Meta integrates Walmart, Gap, and Best Buy into Muse AI agent

claims.claim: Muse now works with Walmart, Gap and Best Buy for groceries, electronics and apparel.
claims.source_title: Meta integrates Walmart, Gap, and Best Buy into Muse AI agent

claims.claim: Shopify and Meta announced agentic checkout with Shop Pay across Shopify stores; approval is required for sensitive actions such as making a purchase.
claims.source_title: Shopify Teams Up With Meta to Let AI Agents Complete Online Purchases

claims.claim: Amazon blocked Meta's Muse AI agent from shopping on Amazon.com.
claims.source_title: Amazon blocks Meta's Muse AI agent from its retail site

claims.claim: Amazon blocked Meta's Muse AI agent from Amazon.com over bot access.
claims.source_title: Amazon Blocks Meta's Muse AI Agent From Shopping on Amazon.com Over Bot Access
